bites.title: Never lose a painting
bites.body: Somebody always loses a painting. Not you.

bites.title: Save as .kra
bites.body: Press {key:file_save|Ctrl+S} and save as a .kra file. KRA keeps every layer, mask and setting. PNG and JPG flatten everything.

bites.title: Incremental versions
bites.body: Press {key:save_incremental_version|Ctrl+Alt+S}. Krita saves painting_001.kra, then _002, and so on. A time machine for your process.

bites.title: Export for sharing
bites.body: File > Export to make a PNG for the web, the LMS or a game engine. The .kra stays your master.

bites.title: The Recorder
bites.body: Open Settings > Dockers > Recorder and press record. Krita captures your painting as you go, and exports a timelapse. Great for portfolios and for seeing your own process.

bites.title: Autosave
bites.body: Settings > Configure Krita > General > File Handling: autosave every few minutes. Turn it on. Thank me later.

bites.title: 23 cleared
bites.body: .kra masters, incremental versions, exports, timelapses, autosave. Bulletproof.
